assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容设计与机器校验；官方图形发布后必须整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 遗址公园保护管控、轨道保护区与周边街区控制条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory protection and control conditions are unknown; this proposal keeps concept-level indications only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 客流、文化消费与夜经济数据仅作概念性匿名聚合引用，不替代官方统计，不涉及任何真实个体信息。
assumptions.statement_en: Visitor-flow and cultural data are concept-level anonymized references only, not official statistics.

assumptions.statement_zh: 轨痕美术馆、枕木回声台与道岔星台设施均为原创概念建议，模块化可逆，不构成建设承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: All node facilities are original reversible conceptual proposals, not construction commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 数字孪生导览与光影联动仅提供匿名聚合与人工复核兜底，不设个体识别采集，不设无法人工终止的自动决定。
assumptions.statement_en: Digital-twin and light-art sensing processes anonymized aggregates only, with human review as backstop.

assumptions.statement_zh: 铁轨艺术季、遗址手作市集与钢轨灯光节等均为建议性设计，不代表已确定的政府安排或投资承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: The event system and phasing are design suggestions, not confirmed government or investment commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 北段铁轨、枕木、道岔及建筑/遗存属性均为待核验线索；档案、逐件测绘、保护评估和权属确认前不作现场事实命名。
assumptions.statement_en: Rails, sleepers, switches and building/heritage attributes are pending leads; no existing-condition naming is made before archival, itemized survey, protection and tenure checks.

assumptions.statement_zh: 清河站、上地/中关村软件园、北纬社区、未来科学城、怀柔科学城、经开区及京津冀均为待确认接口，不预设合作、资源或数据共享。
assumptions.statement_en: Qinghe, Shangdi/Zhongguancun, Beiwei, Future Science City, Huairou Science City, E-Town and Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei are pending interfaces; no cooperation, resource or data sharing is presumed.

assumptions.statement_zh: 三节点选址、消防疏散、设备、无障碍、夜间噪声、维护和资金条件须由责任主体现场核验后才能进入示范。
assumptions.statement_en: Node siting, egress, equipment, accessibility, night disturbance, maintenance and funding require responsible-owner field verification before a pilot.

assumptions.statement_zh: 字体、图件、HTML、PDF和自产几何按权利台账登记；第三方案例只作机制参照，不能转移外部许可或成效。
assumptions.statement_en: Fonts, figures, HTML, PDFs and self-produced geometry follow the rights ledger; third-party cases are mechanism references only and their rights/outcomes are not transferred.
